ud8.7:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā kosalesu addhānamaggapaṭipanno hoti āyasmatā nāgasamālena pacchāsamaṇena.
ud8.7:1.3: addasā kho āyasmā nāgasamālo antarāmagge dvedhāpathaṃ.
ud8.7:1.7: evaṃ vutte bhagavā āyasmantaṃ nāgasamālaṃ etadavoca:
ud8.7:2.2: tatiyampi kho āyasmā nāgasamālo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
ud8.7:2.5: evaṃ vutte bhagavā āyasmantaṃ nāgasamālaṃ etadavoca:
ud8.7:2.8: atha kho āyasmā nāgasamālo bhagavato pattacīvaraṃ tattheva chamāyaṃ nikkhipitvā pakkāmi,
ud8.7:3.1: atha kho āyasmato nāgasamālassa tena panthena gacchantassa antarāmagge corā nikkhamitvā hatthehi ca pādehi ca viheṭhesuṃ, pattañca bhindiṃsu saṅghāṭiñca vipphālesuṃ.
ud8.7:3.2: atha kho āyasmā nāgasamālo bhinnena pattena vipphālitāya saṅghāṭiyā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
ud8.7:3.3: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā nāgasamālo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
ud8.7:3.4: idha mayhaṃ bhante tena panthena gacchantassa antarāmagge corā nikkhamitvā hatthehi ca pādehi ca viheṭhesuṃ, pattañca bhindiṃsu, saṅghāṭiñca vipphālesu’nti.
ud8.7:4.1: atha kho bhagavā etamatthaṃ viditvā tāyaṃ velāyaṃ imaṃ udānaṃ udānesi:
